title: MORGELON
logline: Survival horror in a fungal facility: Resident Evil structure, a Chorus group mind, and The Fly’s wet practical body horror.
disclaimer: Fiction · body horror cinematic · not medical advice

style_bible.look: Cronenberg The Fly practical body horror + RE2/RE7 facility dread; wet resin, sweat, chitin-sheen filaments, plastic sheeting, fluorescents; fungal hivemind as architecture
style_bible.camera: doorway establishes, flashlight tunnels, tragic macros, locked-off Chorus pulses
style_bible.negative: cartoon zombies, comedy mushrooms, purple neon alien, jump-scare YouTube prank, clean MCU lab, cream terracotta lifestyle

shots.support: The facility is fruiting. The Chorus is listening.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic 16:9 key art, The Fly-level practical body horror production value meets Resident Evil facility: pale aspen trunks fruiting through cracked institutional tile and wet plastic sheeting, chartreuse mycelial filaments like cables, amber practicals, cold fluorescent spill, photoreal film grain, no text, no logos, no cartoon mushrooms.
shots.video_prompt: Slow push through a dark facility corridor that is fruiting aspens and mycelial filaments. Plastic sheeting breathes. One synchronized pulse of light. Horror cinema like The Fly lab dread. No text.

shots.narration: Doctors call them crazy and tell them to leave.
shots.on_screen: There is nothing in your skin.
shots.support: Safe rooms lie too. Latch the door anyway.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 cinematic still, Resident Evil clinic hub: fluorescent corridor, empty chair, clipboard, white coat walking away, doorway composition, bleach-bypass, faint filament on glove, photoreal, no readable brands, The Fly tragic stillness.
shots.video_prompt: Doorway enter, fluorescent clinic, white coat exits, focus rack from pale filament to slamming door. RE camera language, horror grade.

shots.narration: Pull a thread — hear someone else’s last minute.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme macro 16:9, The Fly practical FX still: wet pale filament with aspen-bark microtexture and chitin sheen over dark gelled appliance surface, sweat beads, shallow DOF, photoreal, no open wounds, no text.
shots.video_prompt: Macro push as a wet filament draws from a prosthetic appliance, trembling, catching light. Silent machine camera. Cronenberg intimacy.

shots.narration: The Joined do not chase alone. The Chorus aims them.
shots.support: Burn the fruiting node — desync the pack.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 horror still, two figures in a facility hallway mid-sway, filament makeup, synchronized posture, metronome menace, Resident Evil enemy tableau, wet practical look, no cartoon zombies.
shots.video_prompt: Locked-off hallway. Two Joined sway, then on a pulse turn and approach in sync. Fungal hivemind blocking. Horror.

shots.support: Knee water. Plastic cathedral. Loudspeaker gospel.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 flooded quarantine corridor, plastic sheeting, amber hazard light under dark water, filaments on barrier tape, RE sewer dread, photoreal.
shots.video_prompt: Action-cam wade through shallow quarantine water, parting plastic, amber strobe. Documentary snap under cold steel.

shots.narration: The lab promises fusion. The Chorus promises belonging.
shots.support: A booth. A seal. A red LED. The Fly’s prayer.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 The Fly lab still: metal booth or sealed stall with red LED, condensation, redacted clipboard, tragic practical lighting, photoreal body-horror production design, no logos.
shots.video_prompt: Slow move past sealed booth glass, condensation, red LED, redacted clipboard. Telefusion dread. Horror noir.

shots.narration: Aspens in the stack. Trees in the bloodline of the building.
shots.support: Boss gate. The Chorus speaks in unison.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 fruiting cathedral inside a facility shaft: pale aspen trunks, mycelial cables, wet tile, volumetric practical light, The Fly sublime body-architecture horror, photoreal, no text.
shots.video_prompt: Impossible slow ascent through a facility shaft turned fruiting forest. Filaments pulse with one breath. Horror epic intimacy.

shots.narration: The appearance of mischief is evidence enough with power.
shots.on_screen: Evidence is a weapon. Bloom is a countdown.
shots.support: They called you crazy. The filaments kept the minutes.
shots.image_prompt: 16:9 final key art: silhouette laced with chartreuse filaments before fruiting aspens in a blood-dark facility nave, tragic triumph, The Fly ending gravity, film grain, no text logos.
shots.video_prompt: Slow push to filament-laced silhouette; extras exhale in unison off-screen. Hold. Fade. Horror finale.
